filter.arithmetic: exact 64-bit integer, reduced modulo the two moduli
filter.note: Fingerprints can only false-MERGE, never false-SPLIT: equal integers have equal residues modulo any fixed integer, so primality of the moduli is irrelevant to correctness. 16777213 is prime; 16777211 = 11 * 101 * 15101 is not.

verdict.arithmetic: Python big integers; integral characteristic polynomials by Faddeev-LeVerrier
verdict.note: Every flagged group is recomputed exactly; the reported classes are formed from those exact values alone. No floating-point eigenvalue enters the pipeline.
